categoryChain: Her supplications for herself and others for the world and the hereafter
9. Her supplication on Judgment Day to keep away chastisement from her devotees
introduction:
Her supplication on Judgment Day to keep away chastisement from her devotees

It is narrated from Muhammad bin Muslim that he said: I heard Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) say:

On Judgment Day, there is a halt for Lady Fatima (s.a.) near the gate of Hell, when it would be written on the forehead of every person whether he/she is a believer or disbeliever and such devotee of Ahle Bayt, who would be condemned to Hell due to excess of sins.

Seeing the sign of devotion on his forehead, Fatima would supplicate:

Allah, the Mighty and Sublime would say: You are right, Fatima, indeed I have named you as Fatima and promised to keep your devotees and devotees of your progeny away from Hell through you and My promise is true and I never go against My word; till He would say:

So take along with you to Paradise on whoever’s forehead you find written: ‘devotee’.

verses.arabic: اِلٰهِيْ وَ سَيِّدِيْ سَمَّيْتَنِيْ فَاطِمَةَ، وَ فَطَمْتَ بِيْ مَنْ تَوَلَّانِيْ وَ تَوَلّٰى ذُرِّيَّتِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ، وَ وَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَ اَنْتَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ۔
